bias.zh: 反弹乏力 · 受制于 10 日均线，MACD 接近下穿

read.en: Corning slipped 0.3% on Nov 18 to $108.15, trading $106.09–111.35 on light volume (0.46x the 20-day average). It is below the falling 5-day ($111.3), 10-day ($111.5), 30-day ($126.1) and 100-day ($150.3) and the rising 200-day ($156.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, with the histogram near zero, close to a cross down; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($103.95), and RSI is 37.8.
read.zh: 康宁 11月18日小跌 0.3%，收于 $108.15，盘中区间 $106.09–111.35，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.46 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$111.3）、10 日（$111.5）、30 日（$126.1）和 100 日均线（$150.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$156.6）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近零，临近下穿；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$103.95），RSI 为 37.8。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $111.35 high stalled at the 5-day and 10-day averages, and the $106.09 low sat on the $106.1–106.2 closes. Resistance is $108.5–109.9, then $110.1–111.5 (Nov 10 low, averages) and $112.1–114.1. Support is $106.1–106.2, then $104–104.4 (SAR, Nov 6 and 17 lows) and $101.8 (Nov 5 low). A close above $109.9 would target $111.5; below $103.95, the SAR would flip bearish.
